**Mortgage Calculator** is a Shiny application developed in R that calculates the monthly payment of a mortgage based on:
- Mortgage amount
- Mortgage duration
- Annual interest rate

To use the app you have to insert the 3 parameters mentioned below and then click on the button **Calculate monthly payment**. The result will appear below the button.

If you want to change the parameters, you will need to re-run the app, i.e. click again on the button **Calculate monthly payment**
